item.title: Bright spots in Birkenhead regeneration: bringing Eastfloat back to life
item.description: Collective efforts to regenerate the Birkenhead area are a long time in the making and have been hard-fought. Project overruns and intense scrutiny over the use of public funds have cast a long shadow, but we have entered 2026 amid an undeniably bright spot of positive progress, writes Sebastian Gardiner of Peel Ports Logistics. The post Bright spots in Birkenhead regeneration: bringing Eastfloat back to life appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Bloor plots 220 Ormskirk homes
item.description: Outline proposals prepared by Astle Planning & Design have been lodged with West Lancashire Council for the Crosshall Brow site. The post Bloor plots 220 Ormskirk homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Second phase kicks off on Workington Gateway
item.description: The highway improvements project forms part of a wider regeneration package, for which Cumberland Council has secured £33m in government funding. The post Second phase kicks off on Workington Gateway appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: North’s regen impact measured in 25-year progress report by Brabners
item.description: The law firm’s Making Places Work study paints a mixed picture when analysing how effective regeneration projects have been at improving health outcomes for residents. The post North’s regen impact measured in 25-year progress report by Brabners appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Warrington edges towards Birchwood Park disposal
item.description: With budget pressures leading the council to seek an exit, Place North West understands the the 120-acre business estate is under offer to global investment giant Goldman Sachs, working with asset manager Canmoor. The post Warrington edges towards Birchwood Park disposal appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Liverpool Hilton up for sale
item.description: JLL has been appointed to find a buyer for the 221-bed asset, currently owned by Ability Hotels. The post Liverpool Hilton up for sale appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cygnet reveals Blackpool ambitions
item.description: Working with heritage design specialist Buttress, the healthcare firm wants to extend its Newton House facility, also adding a link to and repurposing a grade two-listed church as a therapy centre. The post Cygnet reveals Blackpool ambitions appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Place unveils MIPIM 2026 programme
item.description: From a Dragon’s Den-style showcase of the most investable areas in the North to a deep dive into the region’s untapped economic potential – the North of England MIPIM calendar of events is filled with dynamic and engaging sessions that put the region in the global spotlight. The post Place unveils MIPIM 2026 programme appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Design team picked for £13.2m Innovation Hub
item.description: Lancashire County Council has appointed its professional partners on the delivery of a 30,000 sq ft innovation hub at the Samlesbury Enterprise Zone. The post Design team picked for £13.2m Innovation Hub appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Tameside triggers next stage of Stalybridge regen
item.description: Proposals have been lodged for a 171-space multi-storey car park on Waterloo Road, a move that follows an application for a new footbridge over the River Tame. The post Tameside triggers next stage of Stalybridge regen appeared first on Place North West.
